delete.description: Back to the days in journey/sequences.yml.

put.description:
The whole schedule at once: an email left out of `days` goes back to
its original day, so the screen always sends every email it shows.

get.description:
What an invented firm would be sent, rendered by build_journey with the
screen's edits -- the same path a real lead's drafts take.

delete.description: Back to the wording in journey/copy/.

put.description:
New wording for one template, for every lead from now on. Saving the
original wording back is the same as restoring it.

get.description:
The three steps, what is built in each, and the outside services the
rest waits on. The states come from config/capabilities.yml; whether a
service is switched on is asked of the engine's own seams, so a key
arriving changes this page without anyone editing anything.

The ready leads as a sheet for the sending vendor -- never the
almost-ready, never one the list rules hold back.
